Location
Located in the Willow Glen Planning Area, this area is bordered by the Southern Pacific Railroad, Guadalupe River, Willow Street, Bird Avenue, the back lot line between Fuller and Riverside Drive, Los Gatos Creek, Route 280 and Bird Avenue.
Summary and Recommendations
The substandardness rate indicates a critical housing deterioration problem. The median income is low compared with the City median. The percentage of owner-occupants approximates the City average. A substantial proportion of the population is elderly. Capital improvements needed include the budgeted sanitary sewer line, and unfunded street repairs and park development. The entire area is suitable for continued residential use.
Because of the critical substandardness rate, low income and high elderly population, this area is suitable for CDBG rehabilitation assistance.
